name: Akishino Temari
source:
2nd year high school student, witch course.
The witch course is a special one just for female students, so for the other courses that are filled with guys they're the center of attention.
Temari herself is a little self-conscious about all the attention.
She's a optimistic girl who never gets discouraged, she has the type of personality that is hard to hate.
